part_4_d1_falsified_d3_real.description: Correcting the record wherever D1 (newton_weighted_defect / weighted defect residual) was cited as the mechanism separating on-branch from off-branch profiles.

d1_falsified.claim: D1 does not separate on-branch from off-branch cases at any threshold.
d1_falsified.evidence: leg 226: off-branch D1 range 9.535e-12 to 1.318e+06; on-branch D1 max 9.364e-03. The smallest off-branch D1 value is nine decades BELOW the largest on-branch D1 value -- the ranges overlap catastrophically, there is no threshold that works.
d1_falsified.was_cited_as_mechanism: Leg 226's own dispatch sent it to incorporate D1 as the intended diagnostic. Leg 226's novelty pass (per its journal) called D1 false BEFORE construction; the construction confirms it. This consolidated report is the record correction: wherever a prior document treats newton_weighted_defect / D1 as the off-branch discriminator, it is wrong -- D1 is the diagnostic that was dispatched and disproven, not the one that works.

d3_is_real.claim: D3 (decay-class / far-field inflation) is the discriminator that actually separates.
d3_is_real.evidence: leg 226: on-branch max D3 = 24.06; off-branch min D3 = 197.30 -- clean separation, the pre-committed 100x threshold sits 0.62 decades above the on-branch ceiling and 0.295 decades below the off-branch floor. Validated by a corrected falsification probe (leg 226's Lesson 90 fix) matching predicted-vs-measured D3 to 1.8% worst case with the on/off crossing bracketed between tail=1e-4 and tail=1e-3.
d3_is_real.same_diagnostic_leg236_used: leg 236's exclusion classifier (inherited verbatim from leg 202, thresholds unchanged) is also a far-field-inflation / decay-class measure -- the SAME underlying diagnostic as leg 226's D3, independently re-derived and independently confirmed to separate cleanly. This is why methods A and B in part_1 agree: both ultimately key off the same physical quantity (far-field decay), reached by two different code paths.
